observations: Photo 0 shows a cordless drill with a black and red body, held in hand. The battery pack is labeled '21V MAX LITHIUM'. The chuck has speed settings marked 18-15-17-19-23.
Photo 1 shows the same drill from a different angle, with the chuck speed settings visible: 18-15-17-19-23. The drill appears to be in used condition with some dirt and wear.

Photo 2 shows the drill inside its open black plastic case, with the battery, drill body, and various bits and accessories. The case has molded slots for bits and a handle. The drill is not powered on or in use.
The drill has a red trigger and a red button on the battery pack. The chuck is black with a textured grip.
The case appears to be a standard 12-piece or 15-piece bit set, but only a few bits are visible. The rest are not shown.
The drill is not shown connected to a charger or in operation. No power cord is visible.

claims.claim: The machine is still very new and in good condition
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show visible dirt, wear, and use on the drill and case. The chuck speed settings are worn, and the drill is not in use. The claim of 'very new' is contradicted by the visible condition.

claims.claim: The battery has to be replaced
claims.evidence: No photo shows the battery being replaced or replaced. The battery is shown in the case, but its condition is not visible. The claim is unverifiable from the photos.

risks.risk: The drill may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the drill turning on, spinning, and operating under load.

risks.risk: The battery may be dead or have low capacity, which is not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the drill operating for a few seconds with the battery, or a battery health test.

risks.risk: The drill may have internal damage or wear not visible in the photos, such as worn gears or motor issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the drill operating under load for a few seconds, or a close-up of the motor and gears.

proof_requests: Video of the drill turning on and operating under load.
Video showing the drill operating for a few seconds with the battery.
Close-up of the battery and motor to check for wear or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
